top_signals.title: Oil Extends Drop on Hopes of Diplomatic Progress in Iran War
top_signals.summary: Oil extended a slump amid optimism around diplomatic efforts to end the war in the Middle East, even as attacks in the region continue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
